integrity: Analytical proof accompanied by an exact symbolic checker; universal inequalities follow from the proof and independent external validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Classification is for the deterministic conditional-mean one-step map; no stochastic pathwise or stationary-distribution implication. The five-root threshold is existential over a positive loss offset within a symmetric unit-curvature family; stability asserted for the explicit witness only. Possible equivalent classical rational-iteration formulations require future independent literature review.
title: Five conditional-mean equilibria from two strongly convex NGN losses: a sharp parameter frontier
